title: Hearty Spring Ukrainian Scallion Fritters
description: A delicious and savory Ukrainian dish featuring scallions, perfect for a spring brunch, these fritters are vegetarian-friendly and packed with umami flavor. They are deep-fried to a golden crisp, making them a satisfying treat.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, salt, and pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk.
Add the chopped scallions to the egg mixture and stir to combine.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the scallion mixture into the hot oil, being careful not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
